summary_markdown: The conversation covered two main topics: demographics data and network access. Regarding demographics, the work on 'Tractor Demographics' was paused in favor of working on Citydata demographics for a presentation scheduled for 11 AM BRT concerning parks. The discussion also touched upon technical details regarding VPN connectivity, comparing the current openVPN setup (which lacks real-time status visibility) with a more advanced system that allows granular control over access rights and potentially eliminates the need for separate VPN setups via concept gateways.
decisions: Work on Citydata demographics was prioritized over Tractor Demographics.
